kept.title: Context-gate inject rule: ABSTAIN by default; the exact 5-threshold gate
kept.summary: lib/context-gate.js INJECTs a retrieved note only if ALL hold: top1 cosine >= 0.50 (cosThreshold) AND the top note classifies as 'empirical' (requireEmpirical) AND (margin >= 0.08 OR externalGap >= 0.25) AND projectLocality >= 2 of 4 (localityThreshold). Anything else ABSTAINS. Conservative by construction so every miss is a false-negative (missed win), never a wasted inject.

kept.title: cosThreshold was lowered 0.55->0.50; external-gap, not cosine/margin, discriminates
kept.summary: The first real positive sat at top1=0.548 inside a tight 0.50-0.55 MiniLM topical cluster where neither a raw cosine cut nor a margin cut can separate the true scar from topical near-ties. The external-gap (fraction of the note's content tokens that recur in the task text) does: positive ~0.34 vs every topical negative <=0.17. Thresholds are provisional, calibrated on n=1, and fragile to note supersession (a replacement note can drift below the floor).

kept.title: Note TYPE is inferred from text by regex — notes carry no explicit type field
kept.summary: classifyNoteType derives empirical|principle|neutral purely from text markers (overlay addNoteNode stores no type). An empirical signature wins even if principle words also appear, but pure-principle phrasing ('always/never/best practice/prefer/generally') is DISQUALIFIED from inject because the base model already knows principles. Consequence: phrasing a genuine scar as a principle silently makes it non-injectable.

kept.title: projectLocality guard needs >=2 of 4 categories — phrasing alone can sink a real note
kept.summary: A note must hit >=2 of {measured (%/ N/M ratio), errval (NaN/ERR_/quoted digit/exit code), ident (camelCase/snake_case/path/call), observed ('empirically/discovered/observed/measured')} or the gate ABSTAINS 'non-local' even when the fact IS project-local. A migration-schema note written as plain prose scored locality=1 and was rejected; adding a function name like parseTaskId() or 'discovered empirically' pushes it to 2 and clears the guard.

kept.title: orch-gate FAILS OPEN and exempts a fixed allow-list; /tmp and orch source are NOT exempt
kept.summary: The pre-tool claim gate (hooks/orch-gate.js) allows writes without a claim only for a fixed list: .claude/projects/**/memory/, .claude settings/keybindings/launch.json, .mcp.json, CLAUDE.md, .claude/orchestrator/tasks/, .claude/tasks/, /scratch/, *.log and /logs/. It deliberately does NOT exempt /tmp (//private/tmp) or .claude/orchestrator/ source. It also FAILS OPEN: no session_id, daemon unreachable, or orch-off all -> allow.
